test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 02 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line, facing the north.

Only two people sit to the right of X. Only two people sit between X and C. Only two people sit between A and D. D sits to the immediate left of X. B sits to the immediate right of Y.

Who sits at the third position from the left end of the line?
solution:
**Given:**

Only two people sit to the right of X.

Only two people sit between X and C.

Only two people sit between A and D.

D sits to the immediate left of X.

B sits to the immediate right of Y.

A — C — W — D — X — Y — B

**Hence, the correct answer is W**
